item.title: Version 0.3.10
item.description: Home's bottom buttons (Settings, Statistics, Feedback, Learn the app) now sit in a glass pill, so they stay easy to read over the cards. Behind the scenes: the app's main window code is reorganised and its switches share one design, for easier and safer updates.

item.title: Version 0.3.9
item.description: Words in the Notebook can be sorted by date, A–Z or dialogue. Flashcards: a cleaner sticker card and a language switch (⇄). Check answers works on the first click. The Reader slides in from the top. The slot machine has new Hungarian motifs. Notes work in dark mode. The guide covers the Reader, side by side, Spin a dialogue and the daily review. Also: Patreon's player pauses when the Reader or an exercise takes over, safer link handling in the Reader, downloads get macOS's safety check, faster Home, lower memory use, and many small fixes.

item.title: Version 0.3.8
item.description: New: starred words float on your notes as small flashcards you can flip, and you can print only the starred words. The Notebook groups many notes by week, month and year, and the note icon opens just the note. Stars are now in the Hungarize colour. Fixed: the Back button after opening a dialogue from the Notebook, and the study bar no longer shows under the loading cover.

item.title: Version 0.3.7
item.description: New: the dialogue's audio player now lives in the study bar. In the Reader and over an exercise it opens as a full player under the study bar, or folds into a mini player; the audio carries on where it was when you switch between the Reader and an exercise. Also new: see the dialogue and its translation side by side in the Reader, line by line. The study bar trims to icons in narrow windows, and the loading cover waits until the Reader is ready.

item.title: Version 0.3.6
item.description: New: star words on flashcards or in the Reader's word list, and find them all in Notebook ▸ Words. A short daily review brings starred words back with spaced repetition, and finishing it ticks the day. Also: clearer Study tools settings with Reader defaults and a preview, a real serif font, two dark Reader tones, and better handling of older post titles.

item.title: Version 0.3.5
item.description: New: Spin a dialogue! A slot machine on Home (and Hungarize ▸ Random Dialogue…, ⌘⇧R) picks a dialogue you haven't heard yet, at START, CLASSIC or any level. Pull the lever and listen.

item.title: Version 0.3.4
item.description: Paprikas: every 5 listening days in a row earn one, and a paprika saves your streak if you miss a weekday (see the calendar). Older NAPI DIALÓGUS posts now work in the Reader and with Flashcards. The Reader has dark-mode tones, a monospace font option, and its player is fixed. The study bar shows each tool getting ready, with the Reader first. Birthday greetings, new flashcard print options and dark-mode flashcards.

item.title: Version 0.3.3
item.description: New Reader: read each dialogue calmly in its own font and colours, with the player built in (the Reader button in the study bar). Print flashcards as cut-out cards, a word table, a word search or a crossword. Three flashcard styles. The app can greet you by name. Streaks can be hidden for a calmer view. Exercises and Reader buttons now toggle. The exercise banner is gone.

item.title: Version 0.3.2
item.description: Print now opens the worksheet instantly: it's prepared in the background as soon as a dialogue's study bar appears. The exercise banner is gone; the study bar's Exercises button replaces it. The guided tour and the welcome screens show the new study bar.

item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description: A new study bar under the tabs on each dialogue: Exercises, Flashcards, Notes, Print and playback speed in one place, turning green when finished. Flashcards must be turned over before swiping. Closing the window keeps the app running. The Notes tab is now called Notebook.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description: A big update: a guided tour (Learn the app, on Home), statistics with streaks and a calendar, flashcards from each dialogue's word list, printable worksheets, a default playback speed with per-dialogue speeds, notes from the right-click menu, alerts when new dialogues are out, a taller exercise player and tidier Patreon pages.

item.title: Version 0.2.7
item.description: Home now greets you in Hungarian depending on the time and day, and shows the date, today's name day and a card with a study tip or a special day (click it to flip to the other language). New Settings choices for these, plus fixes.

item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description: Hungarize now also runs on Intel Macs (macOS 13 or later).

item.title: Version 0.2.5
item.description: New Feedback button on Home (and Help ▸ Send Feedback…): tell us what doesn’t work, what could be better, or what you miss.

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description: Help ▸ Run onboarding again now also brings back every tip and banner you turned off. The notes tip has a floppy disk icon, since notes are saved on your Mac.

item.title: Version 0.2.3
item.description: Proofread texts throughout the app in English and Hungarian, and a new Help text that matches how the app works today.

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description: Clicking a dialogue's title in the Database now opens its Patreon post. The last page of the setup wizard is simpler: set up your teachers' page now in Settings, or later.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: Small polish: the two checkboxes in Settings now look the same, and About shows that the app is in beta.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description: The first release of the Hungarize app for Mac: today's dialogues on Home, notes, exercises, the dialogue database, extra services and your teachers' notes in one window.
